description: This Java source file defines the AppResourceRepository class, which manages and merges Android resource repositories from modules and libraries within an Android project, including handling resource IDs and dependencies.

classes.name: AppResourceRepository
classes.description: Manages Android resource repositories, merging resources from modules and libraries, and handles resource ID resolution.

methods.name: getAppResources
methods.description: Retrieves the AppResourceRepository for a given module or AndroidFacet, optionally creating it if necessary.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new AppResourceRepository instance for a given AndroidFacet, initializing resource libraries and repositories.

methods.name: updateRoots
methods.description: Updates the resource roots based on current module dependencies and libraries.

methods.name: findRepositoryFor
methods.description: Finds the FileResourceRepository corresponding to a given AAR directory.

methods.name: resolveResourceId
methods.description: Resolves a resource ID to its resource type and name.

methods.name: resolveStyleable
methods.description: Resolves a styleable resource array to its name.

methods.name: getResourceId
methods.description: Retrieves the resource ID for a given resource type and name.

methods.name: setCompiledResources
methods.description: Sets the resource mappings from compiled resource data.
